title: Isolate QE backtest data freshness from Paper latest-data readiness
description:
QE/backtest factor cache validity must be isolated from Paper/Paper-v2/live latest-data readiness. QE historical backtests should validate data freshness against the requested backtest cutoff (for example 2026-04-30), while Paper/live paths must keep strict current trade-date readiness.

## Observed Behavior
- Current factor cache under `rdagent_assets/factor_values` has 575 parquet entries and all entries have `as_of_date=2026-04-30`.
- The cache is ST PIT labeled (`universe_key=shsz_st_pit_active_v1`, `index_policy=st_pit_buy_eligible_reindexed_v1`) and covers the QE/backtest target window `2018-08-01..2026-04-30`.
- A recent QE generated `prepare_factors.py` with empty `FACTOR_CACHE_EXPECTED_UNIVERSE_META.universe_fingerprint_sha256`, so every cache lookup was rejected with `universe_fingerprint_missing_expected` even though the factor source hash and date coverage were valid.
- The false miss is caused by global ST PIT `dirty=true` being treated as not-ready by `FactorUniverseMaskService.metadata()`, despite `StockUniversePitService.ensure_st_pit_universe(..., end_date=2026-04-30, refresh_policy="coverage")` correctly returning coverage-ready.

## Required Policy Boundary
- QE/backtest profile: historical coverage is sufficient; target end comes from QE `data_split.backtest_end` or the monthly backtest cutoff. It must not require data through the current trading day.
- Paper/Paper-v2/live profile: latest trade-date readiness remains strict and fail-fast for datasets such as ST PIT, `stk_limit`, `suspend_d`, minute bars, and authoritative session inputs.
- Shared services must take an explicit data freshness profile instead of relying on a global latest/dirty state.

## Suspected Code Paths
- `backend/services/quantevolver/factor_universe_mask_service.py`: `metadata()` rejects dirty global state even when the requested historical window is covered.
- `backend/services/quantevolver/config_composer.py`: `_resolve_factor_cache_universe_metadata()` falls back to an empty fingerprint; generated `prepare_factors.py` rejects all cache hits on `universe_fingerprint_missing_expected`.
- `scripts/backfill_factor_cache.py`: uses the same metadata path and may inherit the false latest-data restriction.
- `frontend/src/app/quantevolver/compose/page.tsx` and `frontend/src/app/quantevolver/components/FactorList.tsx`: QE/factor-cache defaults should come from QE config, not Paper/live freshness assumptions or stale hard-coded dates.

## Acceptance Criteria
- QE cache checks for `2018-08-01..2026-04-30` pass when the historical ST PIT window is covered, even if global ST PIT is dirty due later source updates.
- Paper/Paper-v2/live readiness remains strict and continues requiring the configured current/session trade date.
- Generated `prepare_factors.py` no longer disables all cache hits solely because expected fingerprint is missing; it must use an explicit QE/backtest cache policy.
- QE default signal/backtest cutoff can be configured independently from Paper/live defaults and supports monthly cutoff updates.
- Regression tests prove QE and Paper/Paper-v2 data freshness profiles cannot accidentally share the same strict/latest policy.

## Non-goals
- Do not recompute all 575 factor caches just because current trade date is later than 2026-04-30.
- Do not weaken Paper/Paper-v2/live fail-fast checks.
- Do not touch production backend `8001`, frontend `3000`, or production DB as part of issue creation.
reproduce_command: Inspect QE prepare_factors.py/run.log for universe_fingerprint_missing_expected with factor cache as_of_date=2026-04-30; compare StockUniversePitService coverage policy vs FactorUniverseMaskService.metadata dirty rejection.
required_verification: QE/cache path: prove 2018-08-01..2026-04-30 ST PIT/factor cache is accepted under a historical coverage policy even when global ST PIT state is dirty from later data.
Paper/Paper-v2 path: prove latest/session trade-date readiness remains strict and fail-fast for live/replay inputs.
Generated prepare_factors.py: prove cache hits are not disabled solely by missing expected universe fingerprint when universe key/index policy/source hash/date coverage match the QE backtest policy.
closure_requirements: QE and Paper/Paper-v2 data freshness profiles are configured separately and covered by regression tests.
No full 575-factor recompute is required solely because the current trade date is later than the QE cutoff.
Validation evidence is attached before merging to main; production 8001/3000 are not used as the proof path unless explicitly approved.
